breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly repeats and reinforces the error from the incomplete prompt. It instructs to compute the arithmetic-mean area, replace A(x) with it, and treat this substitution as exact — all of which are incorrect. The ground truth simply uses the proper integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx with the actual varying area A(x), with no arithmetic-mean approximation. The agent failed to fix this inconsistency.
